verdict.summary: Balsamic-glazed chicken may pose a gluten risk primarily due to the use of certain sauces and marinades that can contain gluten. It's important to verify the ingredients used in the glaze and any accompanying sides.

disclaimer: This guidance is informational only. Always verify ingredients and preparation with the restaurant.

sections.title: Common gluten risks
